name: Brave Vault Injector
description: Fills logins from Brave Vault via its native host. The credential never reaches an automation agent.
_comment_key: For a STABLE id across machines, set a fixed "key" (Chrome pack) and set BRAVE_VAULT_EXTENSION_ID to the resulting id so the app's native-messaging manifest allow-lists it. For unpacked dev, omit the key, load unpacked, and export BRAVE_VAULT_EXTENSION_ID=<the id Brave assigns>.
